description: Authoritative sensor, subsystem, and GNSS integrity status enums as defined by Architecture Revision 3.

definitions.HEALTHY: Subsystem operating within nominal noise, rate, and latency bounds.
definitions.DEGRADED: Non-critical performance reduction such as thermal rise, dropped samples, or elevated PDOP.
definitions.FAILED: Hardware sensor failure, timeout, or mathematical PSD defect.
definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Subsystem or sensor physically absent or denied by system permissions.
definitions.OUTAGE: External satellite or signal reception loss requiring inertial bridging.
definitions.REACQUISITION_PENDING: Initial fix candidate detected during outage; undergoing consistency checks.
definitions.REACQUIRED: Signal recovery confirmed following dwell window validation.
